description: Pre-built Eclipse Temurin JRE native binaries from the official adoptium/temurin*-binaries GitHub releases. Supports Windows (x64), macOS (x64, arm64) and Linux (x64, arm64) - the platforms Temurin builds (no Windows arm64; macOS arm64 requires Java 11+). The JRE is automatically copied to the runtimes/{rid}/java-native directory during build, and the bundled JavaCli helpers locate it, restore its execute permission, set JAVA_HOME and run it with redirected stdin/stdout/stderr.
title: Java Runtime (JRE) Native Binary
